video_title: Shams Charania details the physical altercation between Bam Adebayo & Tyler Herro | SportsCenter

quotes.speaker: Tyler Herro
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyler Herro addresses his relationship with the Miami Heat organization
quotes.excerpt: It's all love in Miami. I've seen a couple of the guys and the coaching staff.
quotes.quote: It's all love in Miami. I've seen a couple of the guys and the coaching staff, Chris Quinn, Spo, the front office guys. We're all good in Miami and it's just the opportunity for both sides to reset, get a fresh start and we're both super happy for this.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Shams Charania reports on the physical altercation between Bam Adebayo and Tyler Herro
quotes.excerpt: Bam Adebayo struck Tyler Herro in the face area as they were walking off the practice court.

text_blocks.speaker: Kevin Negandhi
text_blocks.text: Shams, you have a wild story in Vegas featuring former teammates. What exactly happened?

text_blocks.speaker: Shams Charania
text_blocks.text: Now former Miami Heat teammates Bam Adebayo and Tyler Herro got into a physical altercation on Friday morning here in Las Vegas. Sources tell me that Bam Adebayo struck Tyler Herro in the face area as they were walking off the practice court at a Las Vegas hotel. This happened when Bam Adebayo approached Tyler Herro about comments that Herro made on social media critiquing Bam after Herro was traded from Miami to Milwaukee over the last couple of weeks. They were teammates for seven years together and we know over the last couple years Herro's name has been in trade talks, but after some social media comments Bam Adebayo approached Tyler Herro on it. That's when they got into a confrontation, a back and forth that culminated in Bam Adebayo striking Tyler Herro.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Shams Charania provides update on potential injuries and league discipline
quotes.excerpt: There was a strike to the face area and now we'll see how much the league does.

text_blocks.speaker: Kevin Negandhi
text_blocks.text: Shams, are you hearing anything about injury sustained in this fight by Tyler Herro?

text_blocks.speaker: Shams Charania
text_blocks.text: There was nothing as far as I'm told as far as an injury or a noticeable cut on Tyler Herro, but there was a strike to the face area and now we'll see how much the league, the players union, what involvement they're going to have here in the coming days.
